about: I am Pintu Naik, a Ph.D. Research Scholar in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu), India.

My research focuses on High-Performance Computing (HPC), Parallel and Distributed Computing, GPU Computing, and Heterogeneous Computing Systems. I am particularly interested in developing scalable and efficient parallel algorithms, GPU-accelerated graph processing, and communication-aware workload scheduling. My recent work also explores high-performance nanopore basecalling on heterogeneous computing architectures, with an emphasis on performance optimization, scalability, and energy efficiency.
